task.question: Why did the Halvern regional grid lose power on the evening of 12 March?

hypotheses.statement: Equipment failure at the Kessel substation transformer.
Deliberate interference with the grid control system.
An operator scheduling error during maintenance.

reports.claim: The Kessel transformer inspection was 14 months overdue.
Thermal imaging recorded a transformer hotspot two weeks earlier.
The manufacturer warned of insulation faults in this model.
Residents reported a loud bang near the substation.
A monitoring firm saw anomalous remote logins that evening.

rivals.claim: The regulator's preliminary note mentions unexplained control-system alarms.
An anonymous post claims a group disabled the grid remotely.

task.question: What caused the fish deaths along the lower Aster River in June?

hypotheses.statement: An unpermitted discharge from the Marrow industrial park.
A natural algal bloom during the heatwave.

reports.claim: Samples below the industrial outfall show elevated solvents.
Deaths begin abruptly downstream of the park.
A park tenant was fined last year for a similar discharge.
Anglers reported an oily sheen near the outfall.
Nitrate levels upstream of the park doubled after the storm.

rivals.claim: Drainage maps show heavy farm runoff into the affected stretch.
A farmers' group acknowledged late fertilizer spreading.

task.question: Why are container vessels queuing outside Port Selby?

hypotheses.statement: An outage of the customs clearance system.
An unannounced work slowdown by crane operators.
Storm damage to the outer berths.

reports.claim: The customs authority confirmed a clearance system failure.
Shipping agents report containers held pending clearance.
Berth occupancy is normal while gate throughput fell.
A trucker video shows long gate queues.
Crane productivity per shift fell by half this week.

rivals.claim: The dockworkers' union called for a work-to-rule action.
A shipping newsletter cites a dispute over overtime pay.

task.question: What started the fire at the Dunmore logistics warehouse on 3 August?

hypotheses.statement: An electrical fault in the forklift charging area.

reports.claim: Fire investigators traced the point of origin to a charging station.
Maintenance logs show repeated breaker trips at the charging bay.
An electrician flagged frayed charger cables during an audit in May.
A night-shift worker remembers a burning plastic smell near the chargers.
A neighbor says the side gate was open that night.

rivals.claim: Police found a broken padlock on the rear loading door.
An anonymous caller claimed someone had threatened to burn the building.

task.question: Why did the wheat harvest in the Varen valley fail this summer?

reports.claim: Laboratory tests found stem rust spores on most sampled plants.
Field surveys mapped rust lesions across the affected farms.
Neighboring regions confirmed a rust outbreak in the same weeks.
Farmers posted photos of orange pustules on their stems.
Several affected farms bought seed from the same supplier.

rivals.claim: The seed supplier recalled one batch for low germination rates.
A cooperative memo questions the purity of this year's seed.

task.question: Why was Corvel Bank's online banking down for six hours on 9 February?

hypotheses.statement: A faulty software update to the login service.
A cooling failure in the primary data center.

reports.claim: The bank's incident report names a login service update deployed that morning.
Deployment logs show the outage began four minutes after the update.
Service returned when the update was rolled back.
A developer forum thread discusses a bug in the new login release.
A traffic monitor saw an unusual spike in requests that day.

rivals.claim: A security firm detected botnet traffic aimed at the bank's domain.
A hacker group claimed responsibility on social media.
